Manage Claude Code and Codex profiles

Usage: larp cc <COMMAND>

Commands:
  profile  Manage profile records (no login, no provider launch)

Options:
  -h, --help  Print help

Data directory: $LARPCC_HOME if set, otherwise $XDG_DATA_HOME/larpcc or ~/.local/share/larpcc (Linux), ~/Library/Application Support/larpcc (macOS), %LOCALAPPDATA%\larpcc (Windows).
